description: Delete Custom Menu Link. Removes a specific custom menu from the system. This operation requires authentication and proper permissions. The custom menu is identified by its unique ID, and the operation is performed within the context of a specific company.

access_token.description: CRM access token (optional — your connected CRM is used when omitted)

body.description: Request body fields for endpoints whose definition declares none (explicit fields win)

location_id.description: CRM sub-account location ID (optional — defaults to your connected location)

name: crm_deleteCustomMenu
